I know there's more to it than that - Gnome has all that other stuff like Glib and KDE isn't just QT - but the GUI is a major consideration.\\\\nSo if I opt for (say) GTK+, will some QT zealot prefer to code an alternative to using my version?\\\\nI run a mixture of Gnome and KDE applications. I use Konqueror as a web browser, Gimp for some graphic stuff, etc. The two toolkits are somewhat annoying because they do not interact particularly well.\\\\nWhen I write a GUI app, I want the interface code to be as separate from the logic as possible, to make swapping them in and out as easy as possible. The 149th was taking part in operations to defeat a Japanese offensive to retake Buri airstrip. He was reportedly killed by an enemy sniper.\\\\nAdams enlisted at Somerset, Kentucky on 8 November 1939, with Company B, 149th Infantry, Kentucky National Guard. He was living at Bethelridge, Casey County, Kentucky, at the time of enlistment and listed his civilian occupation as student. Adams was inducted into federal service with his unit on 6 January 1941. Adams cousin, Delmar Adams (P2, C1, L1), was also killed in this engagement while serving with B Company on 9 December 1944.\\\\nAdams is buried in the Science Hill Cemetery, Science Hill, Pulaski County, Kentucky.\\\\nWhile no definitive information has been found it is believed that the following members of the Kentucky National Guard perished during this engagement in addition to Adams: Edward Stewart Co A, 1-149th 7 December; Willie Alley Co C, 1-149th 8 December; Fred Henson Co C, 1-149th 8 December; Delmar Adams Co B, 1-149th 9 December and Warren Stambaugh HQ Co, 2-149th 10 December.\\\"}, {\\\"text\\\": \\\"I think in glacial terms. As a longtime student of history, I tend to take a very long view of \\\\\\\"current\\\\\\\" events, and I have a strong belief in the resilience of the human spirit. I love this country, even with all its problems, and as Winston Churchill once said, \\\\\\\"It has been said that democracy is the worst form of government except all the others that have been tried.\\\\\\\" Perhaps that is true...the checks and balances DO seem to work for us, over time, if a bit frighteningly unbalanced at any given moment.\\\\nThen this image intruded itself into my mind, and would NOT go away. An argument with an old old friend forced my hand, at least internally, and I knew I had to paint it...the pivotal moment when the second plane hit the Twin Towers, and what has happened to us as a country since.\\\\nLike almost everyone, I was deeply affected by that event, for a variety of reasons. It took a long time not to react to every plane that flew over, not to dread the news for fear of what might have happened next, not to fear for my friends and loved ones who were in harm's way. We lost a great deal of innocence and our sense of safety that day, along with thousands of innocent lives. The courage we saw in those who helped the survivors, and the caring between those people themselves was awe-inspiring. It affected us, and the world--and continues to affect us, for good or ill.\\\\nAt first we DID pull together, as a people--here and abroad. What has happened since is increasingly painful. My painting is about that matrix.\\\\nSo many decisions to be made, when tackling a subject like this...what size, what palette, what format, and more importantly, how much to spell out, what to leave ambiguous? It has not been a fun painting, or a relaxing one, but one I needed to do.\\\\nAt first I thought I would not be able to bear to LOOK at it, and wondered how I could do a painting I'd have to hide from myself. But I find looking at it is healing, for me.\\\\nAnd yes, this is a self portrait in many senses of the word...it is about my feelings, my experience, my feeling caught in the middle, my despair...and I used myself as a model, in the center.\\\"}]\", \"stderr\": \"\", \"return_code\": 0}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {\"elapsed_seconds\": 0.65}}"}

BUDGET = 0.25
MAX_2BIT = 8


def load_wt2_reference():
    with open(WT2_REF_FILE) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    for r in data["results"]:
        if abs(r["budget"] - BUDGET) < 1e-6:
            return r
    raise ValueError(f"No budget={BUDGET} entry in {WT2_REF_FILE}")


def compute_agreement(alloc_a, alloc_b):
    keys = set(alloc_a.keys()) & set(alloc_b.keys())
    if not keys:
        return 0.0, {}
    agree = 0
    disagree_details = {}
    for k in sorted(keys):
        a_type, a_param = alloc_a[k]
        b_type, b_param = alloc_b[k]
        if a_type == b_type and a_param == b_param:
            agree += 1
        else:
            disagree_details[k] = {"wt2": [a_type, a_param], "c4": [b_type, b_param]}
    return agree / len(keys), disagree_details

    profiling_output = {

        "baseline_calibration_ppl": baseline_cal_ppl,
        "profile_time_seconds": profile_time,

                break

Input: model + allocation decisions
Output: perplexity number
"""

import argparse
import importlib
import json
import math
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from utils import quantize_per_channel, quantize_per_token, repeat_kv


def _get_rotary_fn(model):
    """Import apply_rotary_pos_emb matching the model architecture."""
    model_type = model.config.model_type
    module_name = f"transformers.models.{model_type}.modeling_{model_type}"
    module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
    return module.apply_rotary_pos_emb


def patch_attention(model, allocations):
    """Monkey-patch attention layers to apply per-head compression.

    Returns dict of original forward methods for restoration.
    """
    config = model.config
    num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
    num_q_heads = config.num_attention_heads
    head_dim = config.hidden_size // num_q_heads
    n_groups = num_q_heads // num_kv_heads

    rotary_fn = _get_rotary_fn(model)
    original_forwards = {}

    for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(model.model.layers):
        attn = layer.self_attn

        head_allocs = {}
        for h in range(num_kv_heads):
            key = f"{layer_idx},{h}"
            if key in allocations:
                atype, param = allocations[key]
                head_allocs[h] = (atype, param)
            else:
                head_allocs[h] = ("full", 16)

        all_full = all(a[0] == "full" for a in head_allocs.values())
        if all_full:
            continue

        has_eviction = any(a[0] == "evict" for a in head_allocs.values())
        original_forwards[layer_idx] = attn.forward

        def make_forward(orig_attn, h_allocs, has_evict, n_kv=num_kv_heads, ng=n_groups, hd=head_dim, rope_fn=rotary_fn):
            def compressed_forward(hidden_states, position_embeddings, attention_mask=None, **kwargs):
                bsz, seq_len = hidden_states.shape[:2]

                q = orig_attn.q_proj(hidden_states).view(bsz, seq_len, -1, hd).transpose(1, 2)
                k = orig_attn.k_proj(hidden_states).view(bsz, seq_len, n_kv, hd).transpose(1, 2)
                v = orig_attn.v_proj(hidden_states).view(bsz, seq_len, n_kv, hd).transpose(1, 2)

                cos, sin = position_embeddings
                q, k = rope_fn(q, k, cos, sin)

                # Per-head quantization
                for h in range(n_kv):
                    atype, param = h_allocs[h]
                    if atype == "quant" and int(param) < 16:
                        bits = int(param)
                        k[:, h] = quantize_per_channel(k[:, h:h + 1], bits).squeeze(1)
                        v[:, h] = quantize_per_token(v[:, h:h + 1], bits).squeeze(1)

                k_exp = repeat_kv(k, ng)
                v_exp = repeat_kv(v, ng)

                attn_scores = torch.matmul(q, k_exp.transpose(2, 3)) * orig_attn.scaling
                if attention_mask is not None:
                    cm = attention_mask[:, :, :, :k_exp.shape[-2]]
                    attn_scores = attn_scores + cm
                else:
                    causal = torch.triu(
                        torch.full((seq_len, seq_len), float("-inf"),
                                   device=attn_scores.device, dtype=attn_scores.dtype),
                        diagonal=1
                    )
                    attn_scores = attn_scores + causal

                # Eviction: compute importance from initial softmax, then mask and re-softmax
                if has_evict:
                    soft_w = F.softmax(attn_scores, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32)
                    for h in range(n_kv):
                        atype, param = h_allocs[h]
                        if atype == "evict":
                            ratio = float(param)
                            skv = k.shape[2]
                            n_keep = max(1, int(skv * ratio))
                            qs, qe = h * ng, (h + 1) * ng
                            importance = soft_w[:, qs:qe].mean(dim=(0, 1, 2))
                            _, top_idx = importance.topk(n_keep)
                            emask = torch.full(
                                (skv,), float("-inf"), device=k.device, dtype=attn_scores.dtype
                            )
                            emask[top_idx] = 0
                            attn_scores[:, qs:qe] = attn_scores[:, qs:qe] + emask

                attn_w = F.softmax(attn_scores, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(q.dtype)
                out = torch.matmul(attn_w, v_exp)
                out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().reshape(bsz, seq_len, -1)
                out = orig_attn.o_proj(out)
                return out, attn_w

            return compressed_forward

        attn.forward = make_forward(attn, head_allocs, has_eviction)

    return original_forwards


def restore_attention(model, original_forwards):
    """Restore original attention forwards."""
    for layer_idx, fwd in original_forwards.items():
        model.model.layers[layer_idx].self_attn.forward = fwd


def evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, device, stride=512):
    """Evaluate perplexity on WikiText-2."""
    from datasets import load_dataset, Dataset

    try:
        ds = load_dataset("wikitext", "wikitext-2-raw-v1", split="test")
    except Exception:
        arrow_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/datasets/wikitext/wikitext-2-raw-v1/0.0.0/b08601e04326c79dfdd32d625aee71d232d685c3/wikitext-test.arrow"
        print(f"  Hub unavailable, loading from arrow: {arrow_path}")
        ds = Dataset.from_file(arrow_path)
    text = "\n\n".join([t for t in ds["text"] if t.strip()])

    encodings = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt")
    input_ids = encodings.input_ids.to(device)
    total_len = input_ids.shape[1]

    total_loss = 0.0
    total_tokens = 0
    n_chunks = (total_len - 1) // stride

    print(f"Evaluating perplexity on {total_len} tokens, stride={stride}, {n_chunks} chunks")

    for i, begin in enumerate(range(0, total_len - 1, stride)):
        end = min(begin + stride, total_len)
        chunk = input_ids[:, begin:end]

        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model(chunk, use_cache=False, cache_position=torch.arange(chunk.shape[1], device=chunk.device))
            logits = outputs.logits

        shift_logits = logits[:, :-1].contiguous()
        shift_labels = chunk[:, 1:].contiguous()

        loss = F.cross_entropy(
            shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.shape[-1]),
            shift_labels.view(-1),
            reduction="sum",
        )
        total_loss += loss.item()
        total_tokens += shift_labels.numel()

        if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
            print(f"  chunk {i + 1}/{n_chunks}, running ppl={math.exp(total_loss / total_tokens):.2f}")

    ppl = math.exp(total_loss / total_tokens)
    return ppl


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--model", type=str, default="Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B")
    parser.add_argument("--allocation", type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--device", type=str, default="cuda:0")
    parser.add_argument("--stride", type=int, default=512)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    with open(args.allocation) as f:
        alloc_data = json.load(f)
    allocations = alloc_data["allocation"]

    print(f"Loading model {args.model}...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        args.model, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="eager"
    )
    model = model.to(args.device)
    model.eval()

    print("Patching attention layers...")
    orig_fwds = patch_attention(model, allocations)

    ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, args.device, args.stride)
    print(f"Perplexity: {ppl:.2f}")

    restore_attention(model, orig_fwds)
    return ppl


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
import math
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from eval_ppl import patch_attention, restore_attention


class FullBitwidthProfiler:
    def __init__(self, model_path, calibration_data, device='cuda:0',
                 num_samples=16, seq_len=512):
        self.device = device
        self.seq_len = seq_len
        self.num_samples = num_samples

        print(f"Loading model {model_path}...")
        self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path)
        self.model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
            model_path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="eager"
        )
        self.model = self.model.to(device)
        self.model.eval()

        config = self.model.config
        self.num_layers = config.num_hidden_layers
        self.num_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads

        self.input_ids = self._load_calibration_data(calibration_data)
        total_heads = self.num_layers * self.num_kv_heads
        print(f"Config: {self.num_layers} layers, {self.num_kv_heads} KV heads/layer, "
              f"{total_heads} heads total")
        print(f"Calibration: {self.input_ids.shape[0]} seqs x {self.input_ids.shape[1]} tokens")

        self._baseline_ppl = None

    def _load_calibration_data(self, path):
        with open(path) as f:
            samples = json.load(f)
        all_ids = []
        for s in samples:
            tokens = self.tokenizer.encode(s["text"], add_special_tokens=False)
            if len(tokens) >= self.seq_len:
                all_ids.append(tokens[:self.seq_len])
            if len(all_ids) >= self.num_samples:
                break
        if not all_ids:
            raise RuntimeError(f"No calibration seqs with >= {self.seq_len} tokens")
        return torch.tensor(all_ids, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device)

    def _compute_ppl(self):
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = self.model(
                self.input_ids, use_cache=False,
                cache_position=torch.arange(self.seq_len, device=self.device)
            )
        shift_logits = outputs.logits[:, :-1].contiguous()
        shift_labels = self.input_ids[:, 1:].contiguous()
        loss = F.cross_entropy(
            shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.shape[-1]),
            shift_labels.view(-1),
            reduction="sum"
        )
        total_tokens = shift_labels.numel()
        return math.exp(loss.item() / total_tokens)

    def compute_baseline_ppl(self):
        if self._baseline_ppl is None:
            print("Computing baseline PPL...")
            self._baseline_ppl = self._compute_ppl()
            print(f"Baseline PPL: {self._baseline_ppl:.4f}")
        return self._baseline_ppl

    def profile_single_head(self, layer, head, bits):
        _ = self.compute_baseline_ppl()
        if bits >= 16:
            return 0.0
        allocations = {f"{layer},{head}": ["quant", bits]}
        orig_fwds = patch_attention(self.model, allocations)
        ppl = self._compute_ppl()
        restore_attention(self.model, orig_fwds)
        return ppl - self._baseline_ppl

    def profile_all(self, bit_widths=(2, 4, 8)):
        _ = self.compute_baseline_ppl()
        total_heads = self.num_layers * self.num_kv_heads
        total_evals = total_heads * len(bit_widths)
        done = 0

        profiles = {}
        for l in range(self.num_layers):
            profiles[str(l)] = {}
            for h in range(self.num_kv_heads):
                head_profile = {"quantization": {}}
                for bits in bit_widths:
                    delta = self.profile_single_head(l, h, bits)
                    head_profile["quantization"][str(bits)] = delta
                    done += 1
                    print(f"[{done}/{total_evals}] L{l}H{h} @{bits}bit: delta={delta:.6f}")
                profiles[str(l)][str(h)] = head_profile

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": """"Quantization utilities and attention helpers for ratekv MVP."""

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F


def quantize_per_channel(tensor, bits):
    """Symmetric uniform quantization per channel (last dim)."""
    qmax = 2 ** (bits - 1) - 1
    abs_max = tensor.abs().amax(dim=-2, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-8)
    scale = abs_max / qmax
    return (tensor / scale).round().clamp(-qmax - 1, qmax) * scale


def quantize_per_token(tensor, bits):
    """Symmetric uniform quantization per token (second-to-last dim)."""
    qmax = 2 ** (bits - 1) - 1
    abs_max = tensor.abs().amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-8)
    scale = abs_max / qmax
    return (tensor / scale).round().clamp(-qmax - 1, qmax) * scale


def repeat_kv(hidden_states, n_rep):
    """Repeat KV heads for GQA."""
    if n_rep == 1:
        return hidden_states
    batch, n_kv, seq_len, head_dim = hidden_states.shape
    hidden_states = hidden_states[:, :, None, :, :].expand(batch, n_kv, n_rep, seq_len, head_dim)
    return hidden_states.reshape(batch, n_kv * n_rep, seq_len, head_dim)


def compute_attention_output(Q, K, V, causal_mask=None):
    """Scaled dot-product attention with GQA support.

    Args:
        Q: (batch, n_heads, seq_q, head_dim)
        K: (batch, n_kv_heads, seq_kv, head_dim)
        V: (batch, n_kv_heads, seq_kv, head_dim)
        causal_mask: (seq_q, seq_kv) additive mask (-inf for masked)
    Returns:
        output: (batch, n_heads, seq_q, head_dim)
        attn_weights: (batch, n_heads, seq_q, seq_kv)
    """
    n_heads = Q.shape[1]
    n_kv_heads = K.shape[1]
    head_dim = Q.shape[-1]
    n_groups = n_heads // n_kv_heads

    if n_groups > 1:
        K = K.repeat_interleave(n_groups, dim=1)
        V = V.repeat_interleave(n_groups, dim=1)

    scale = 1.0 / (head_dim ** 0.5)
    attn_weights = torch.matmul(Q, K.transpose(-2, -1)) * scale

    if causal_mask is not None:
        attn_weights = attn_weights + causal_mask

    attn_weights = F.softmax(attn_weights, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(Q.dtype)
    output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, V)
    return output, attn_weights


def expected_attention_scores(attn_weights, n_kv_heads):
    """Expected Attention importance per KV position per head.

    Args:
        attn_weights: (batch, n_query_heads, seq_q, seq_kv)
        n_kv_heads: number of KV heads
    Returns:
        (n_kv_heads, seq_kv)
    """
    n_query_heads = attn_weights.shape[1]
    gqa_ratio = n_query_heads // n_kv_heads
    scores = []
    for h in range(n_kv_heads):
        s = h * gqa_ratio
        head_w = attn_weights[:, s:s + gqa_ratio]
        scores.append(head_w.float().mean(dim=(0, 1, 2)))
    return torch.stack(scores)


def eviction_memory_ratio(retention_ratio):
    return retention_ratio


def quantization_memory_ratio(bits):
    return bits / 16.0

DEVICE = "cuda:0"
BUDGET = 0.25
MAX_2BIT = 8
SEQ_LEN = 2048

def build_cal_ids(text, tokenizer, max_samples, seq_len, device):
    token_ids = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
    chunks = []
    for i in range(0, len(token_ids) - seq_len + 1, seq_len):
        chunks.append(token_ids[i:i + seq_len])
        if len(chunks) >= max_samples:
            break
    if not chunks:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No seqs of len {seq_len} from {len(token_ids)} tokens")
    return torch.tensor(chunks, dtype=torch.long, device=device), len(chunks)


def compute_ppl(model, input_ids, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE):
    total_loss = 0.0
    total_tokens = 0
    n = input_ids.shape[0]
    sl = input_ids.shape[1]
    with torch.no_grad():
        for s in range(0, n, batch_size):
            e = min(s + batch_size, n)
            batch = input_ids[s:e]
            out = model(batch, use_cache=False,
                       cache_position=torch.arange(sl, device=batch.device))
            logits = out.logits[:, :-1].contiguous()
            labels = batch[:, 1:].contiguous()
            loss = F.cross_entropy(
                logits.view(-1, logits.shape[-1]),
                labels.view(-1), reduction="sum")
            total_loss += loss.item()
            total_tokens += labels.numel()
            del out, logits, loss
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    return math.exp(total_loss / total_tokens)


def profile_heads(model, input_ids, n_layers, n_kv_heads):
    baseline = compute_ppl(model, input_ids)
    print(f"  Calibration baseline PPL: {baseline:.4f}", flush=True)
    total = n_layers * n_kv_heads * len(BIT_WIDTHS)
    done = 0
    profiles = {}
    for l in range(n_layers):
        profiles[str(l)] = {}
        for h in range(n_kv_heads):
            hp = {"quantization": {}}
            for bits in BIT_WIDTHS:
                orig = patch_attention(model, {f"{l},{h}": ["quant", bits]})
                ppl = compute_ppl(model, input_ids)
                restore_attention(model, orig)
                delta = ppl - baseline
                hp["quantization"][str(bits)] = delta
                done += 1
                if done % 28 == 0 or done == total:
                    print(f"  [{done}/{total}] L{l}H{h}@{bits}b d={delta:.6f}", flush=True)

    return mckp, uniform


def calc_agreement(alloc_a, alloc_b):
    keys = set(alloc_a) & set(alloc_b)
    if not keys:

    agree = 0
    diff = {}
    for k in sorted(keys):
        if alloc_a[k] == alloc_b[k]:
            agree += 1
        else:
            diff[k] = {"a": alloc_a[k], "b": alloc_b[k]}
    return agree / len(keys), agree, len(keys), diff

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(

    c4_cal_text = "\n\n".join(s["text"] for s in c4_cal_entries)
    c4_eval_text = "\n\n".join(s["text"] for s in c4_eval_entries)
    c4_cal_ids, c4_cal_n = build_cal_ids(c4_cal_text, tokenizer, 256, SEQ_LEN, DEVICE)
